notes: 02: only title+description fetched; favicon and preview image never collected or stored. 07: list items show title/description/tags but no favicon (none stored). 10: save form shows a static clickable 'Reuse' list of all existing tags, not typeahead autocomplete matching typed input; edit form offers no suggestions at all. 14: search haystack includes tag names but strips '#', so '#tag' syntax is not handled as tag search. 15: matches() only does implicit AND across tokens; no OR/NOT operators or parenthesised groups. 16: query split on whitespace with quotes treated as literal chars; no exact-phrase matching. 20: no multi-select or bulk action in UI or API. 21: no bulk-over-filter action exists. 22: list fixed to ORDER BY id DESC (date added); no user-selectable sort key (title, etc.). 23: note field stored and rendered as escaped plain text via highlight(); no markdown rendering. 24: no snapshot feature (no local HTML capture, no PDF rule). 25: no Internet Archive integration. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no Netscape HTML export. 32: no user settings for sort/displayed items/font size.
